steps: Attach the X and A axes to the same logical machine
Check the logical machine assignment of the X and A axes
Restart the CNC system to apply changes to logical machine assignments
Detach the x' axis from logical machine 2
Check the current logical machine attachment of the x' axis
Restart the part program processor
Verify the x' axis is no longer attached to logical machine 2
Verify the part program 'm101.pp' exists in the configured search hierarchy.
Check the search hierarchy path for the correct location of 'm101.pp'.
Ensure the part program 'm101.pp' is not overridden by another program with the same name in the search hierarchy.
Add at least three control points between `splineon` and `splineoff` commands.
Check the spline type and ensure it is compatible with the number of control points.
Verify the `splineon` and `splineoff` commands are correctly placed in the program.
Check the program for any `sync` commands that may break the spline prematurely.
Verify the tension factor is set appropriately if using uniform or chord-length splines.
Check the block for more than one class 1 preparatory word.
Remove or replace any additional class 1 preparatory word in the block.
Verify the block syntax follows the rule of one class 1 preparatory word per block.
Restart the system
Check the logical device 5 mapping in the joint parameters
Verify each joint's logical device setting is unique
Set the Joint logical device parameter to the correct logical address
Ensure no other joint is assigned the same logical device address
Check the Device EtherCAT address for logical device 5
Verify the Device name and logical device settings are consistent
Disable the OPC UA server by setting `opcua.enable` to `false`.
Check the license includes the OPC UA server option.
Purchase the OPC UA server option if required.
Verify the OPC UA server is disabled.
Restart the system
Reinitialise the EtherCAT bus
Verify the device's operational state matches the Master's expected state
Restart the system
Reinitialise the Ethercat bus
Check the drive's reported error register
Verify the error code and error register values
Restart the system
Check the EtherCAT cable connections
Verify the cyclic task configuration
Check the drive's reported error register
Check for interference on the EtherCAT network
Check the CRC settings on the master and slave devices
Check the EtherCAT master configuration
Check the drive firmware version
Check the EtherCAT slave configuration
Check the network topology for correct device addressing
Upload firmware to device Drive_3
Start AMCore in device mode
Verify firmware version of Drive_3
Check fieldbus state is PREOP
